how: botcore s74 rolls each bot's armor from Reach's own Armory catalog (native/reach.cpp hr_roll_armor), one random item and variant per slot in the mask, from the bot's profile seed (the same every match). Slots, from live probes on Oct 24 (logs/looks/slots_sheet.png): 0 helmet, 1 left shoulder, 2 right shoulder, 3 chest, 4 wrist, 5 utility, 6 knee guards, 7 visor colour (6 and 7 subtle in the probe photos); 8 armor effect, 9-12 nothing visible on a Spartan: Reach's slot names (FUN_18024334c, one place up: 9 armor_effect = live 8) put the emblem and elite_armor there (elite_armor = slot 11). Mask 7935 = slots 0-7 and 9-12: every Elite was in the owner's Elite armor in Invasion (owner, Oct 24) while only 0-7 were rolled. effects: the armor effect slot, never left as the owner's (owner, Oct 24: every bot copied their flames). brain/looks.py sets it to the catalog's first item (none) unless armor effects are on in the bot profiles (the PvP Bots Mod tab's re-roll) and the bot is one of the ~35% that wear one; then it is rolled like the rest (botcore s78 none mask). Colours (Oct 26 evening, the owner's Forge World BOT OBSERVER map, TU Juggernaut so each wears its own): +0x49 primary, +0x4A secondary, the same places as Halo 4 and H2A (the owner's yellow / green read 28 / 10 in all three); secondary 0 steel, 29 its own pale shade, 30 the white fallback past the list: 0-29, Reach's 30 colours. Laid over the rolled configuration as (offset, value) pairs (native/reach.cpp), so bots stop wearing the owner's colours. Oct 28: the slots' own catalog writes (botcore s104 log, tools/armory_tables.py -> maps/_looks/reach_armory.json) put slot 6 on the visor tint (appearance +0x2B) and slot 7 on the knee guards (+0x3E; Reach names the slot paint_scheme), slot 9 on the Elite's armor set and slot 12 on the firefight voice (12 variants, its equip faults outside a match); the offline roll (brain/armory.py) matched all 15 bots' bytes read live on Boardwalk (Oct 27). Gender (owner, Oct 28: "havent noticed any female characters in reach make this about 20% chance and editable in the bot profile"): +0x4C, rolled last (so every bot keeps its colours) 1 in 5 female, set by hand in the profile view (reach.gender). The game clamps the byte to 0-2 and the map's customization table marks pieces by body with masks 1 / 2 / 4, read as male / female / Elite, so 1 is taken to be female: NOT CONFIRMED LIVE (the Oct 24 probe of 1 was inconclusive). Original / Modern (Oct 28, docs/HANDOFF_armor_oct28.md): the catalog is the 2010 Armory and nothing else: HREK's ui/supply_depot.cookie_purchase_globals (credit prices and rank gates per item, the Haunted helmet at 1 cR and grade 20) lists exactly the logged items in the logged order, and its strings name them (18 shoulders, all in the 2010 Armory with prices, UA/Base Security and Mjolnir Mk. V included; 18 chests, the [W] ones as DLC / Waypoint unlocks). So the catalog roll is Original as it is. MCC added rows only to the map's customization table (20_sword_slayer.map, the order MCC-Win64-Shipping.exe lists HR_Helmet_*): helmets 64-89 (Mariner, GRD, Belos, Blackguard, Drengr), chests 1-2 (the plain UA/Base Security and UA/Multi-Threat, never in the 2010 Armory) and 20-25 (robot-arm chests, Condemned), utility 6 (Vacuum Flask). Modern only: the 'mcc' fields put one of them on the bot by its table index over the roll (helmet +0x58, chest +0x5B, utility +0x5D, as the catalog's own equip writes those bytes), a bot wearing one as often as the table's share (26 of 90 helmets, 8 of 26 chests, 1 of 7 utilities): NOT SEEN LIVE. Mask 3839: slot 12 (the Firefight voice) is not armor and its equip faulted every roll (s104), so it is not rolled; native/reach.cpp skips it too. Bot editor (Oct 28 night, owner: "Cant customize reach armor from bot profile", "Elites not changeable for reach"): every armor slot (helmet, shoulders, chest, wrist, utility, knees, visor tint +0x4B, the Elite armor +0x5F) can be set by hand; its table index is laid over the roll as MCC items are (botcore lays any configuration byte), Original only the 2010 Armory values. Names: tools/look_names.py from HREK ui/supply_depot.cookie_purchase_globals (the catalog order, every item tied to the value its equip writes). Slots other than helmet, chest and utility NOT SEEN LIVE laid over the roll.
